stories.title: Precios del petróleo ampliaron su alza tras disiparse acuerdo sobre estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: Oil prices extended gains after Strait of Hormuz agreement dissolved
en.summary: Oil prices rose further as diplomatic efforts around the Strait of Hormuz collapsed. The waterway, through which 20% of global oil and gas production flowed before the conflict, has remained largely blocked by Iran since fighting began on February 28.

stories.title: Morena designa a Manuel Alejandro Cota como su representante en BCS; pertenece al Partido Verde

en.title: Morena designates Manuel Alejandro Cota as its representative in BCS; belongs to Green Party
en.summary: Morena party has appointed Manuel Alejandro Cota as its representative in Baja California Sur. Cota is affiliated with the Green Party.

stories.title: Va Manuel Cota por Gubernatura de BCS con Morena

en.title: Manuel Cota runs for Governor of BCS with Morena
en.summary: Manuel Cota Cárdenas from the PVEM was presented by Morena as coordinator for the Baja California Sur gubernatorial race.

stories.title: Morena designa a Lorenia Valles como coordinadora en Sonora; militantes protestan por su nombramiento

en.title: Morena designates Lorenia Valles as coordinator in Sonora; activists protest her appointment
en.summary: Morena party appointed Lorenia Valles as coordinator in Sonora. Party members protested against the appointment.

stories.title: Controlan incendio en Heroica Mulegé, Baja California Sur; fuego se aproximó a viviendas en medio del huracán Polo

en.title: Fire controlled in Heroica Mulegé, Baja California Sur; blaze approached homes amid Hurricane Polo
en.summary: Authorities partially contained a fire in Heroica Mulegé during Hurricane Polo, as emergency responders continued operations in an area where the fire had approached residential homes.

stories.title: Elige Morena a Lorenia Valles en Sonora

en.title: Morena selects Lorenia Valles in Sonora
en.summary: The Morena party designated Lorenia Valles as its coordinator in Sonora for her candidacy to the state governorship.

stories.title: Clara Luz Flores es elegida coordinadora de Morena en Nuevo León, rumbo a 2027

en.title: Clara Luz Flores elected Morena coordinator in Nuevo León, ahead of 2027
en.summary: Morena chose Clara Luz Flores as its coordinator in Nuevo León through a process the party characterized as transparent, horizontal, and democratic.

stories.title: Huracán Polo: ¿A qué hora impactará a Baja California Sur?

en.title: Hurricane Polo: What time will it impact Baja California Sur?
en.summary: Hurricane Polo will bring sustained winds of 170 to 190 km/h and gusts reaching 220 to 240 km/h to Baja California Sur on the afternoon and evening of Monday, September 28.

stories.title: Morena nombra a Clara Luz Flores coordinadora de transformación en Nuevo León; irán en alianza con el PVEM

en.title: Morena appoints Clara Luz Flores as coordinator of transformation in Nuevo León; will run in alliance with the PVEM
en.summary: Mexico's Morena party has named Clara Luz Flores as transformation coordinator in Nuevo León state, with plans to campaign in coalition with the PVEM party.

stories.title: Polo will make landfall in Baja California Sur today. What you need to know

en.title: Polo will make landfall in Baja California Sur today. What you need to know
en.summary: Hurricane Polo, a Category 3 storm with winds of approximately 185 kilometers per hour, is expected to make landfall in Baja California Sur before 6 p.m. today, with gusts reaching up to 220 kilometers per hour.

stories.title: Huracán Polo sigue como categoría 3 y tormenta tropical Rachel avanza; sigue EN VIVO su avance y efectos

en.title: Hurricane Polo continues as Category 3; tropical storm Rachel advances; tracking live updates and impacts
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintains maximum winds of 185 km/h while approaching Baja California Sur, while tropical storm Rachel brings heavy rainfall to Guerrero and Oaxaca.

stories.title: Precios del petróleo, de nuevo al alza

en.title: Oil prices rise again
en.summary: Oil prices increased following Iran's continued calls for diplomatic resolution to its conflict with the United States and Israel, after Trump rejected Iran's proposal regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Carlos Slim convirtió tres estaciones del Metro en negocio y puso plazas comerciales donde miles pasan cada día

en.title: Carlos Slim converted three Metro stations into business and placed shopping plazas where thousands pass daily
en.summary: Three Mexico City Metro stations house commercial developments linked to Inmuebles Carso, the real estate company of the Slim family group.

stories.title: Pemex arrastra calificación de México a grado especulativo: Alejandro Werner; prevé déficits fiscales de 4 a 5% a 2030

en.title: Pemex drags Mexico's rating to speculative grade: Alejandro Werner; forecasts fiscal deficits of 4 to 5% by 2030
en.summary: Stabilizing Mexico's debt requires improving the primary balance through tax reform, which recent governments have failed to achieve for state oil company Pemex, according to a former finance official.

stories.title: Geely supera a MG en ventas y acecha a BYD

en.title: Geely surpasses MG in sales and closes in on BYD
en.summary: The Chinese automaker Geely exceeded MG in monthly sales for the first time in August and is gaining ground on BYD, which leads Chinese brands operating in Mexico.

stories.title: Mexicana suma su avión número 10 y alcanza la mitad de la flota que usará para ampliar sus rutas nacionales

en.title: Mexicana adds its 10th aircraft and reaches half the fleet it will use to expand domestic routes
en.summary: Mexicana airline received an Embraer 190 E2 aircraft from Brazil, bringing its fleet to 10 planes as part of expansion plans for domestic service.

stories.title: Acereras de EU redoblan la presión a Trump por los aranceles ante un posible acuerdo con México

en.title: U.S. steelmakers intensify pressure on Trump over tariffs amid possible agreement with Mexico
en.summary: Mexican exports of steel and steel products declined 10.6% in 2025 and fell 7.1% between January and July 2026.
